title: Operating points and assumed component values of the architecture trade-off examples (Figure 8)
model: Panels a,b: bidirectional single-/double-pass EDFA model of edfa_multipass.py with fiber card EDFA-GD91-T1. Panel c: counter-pumped distributed Raman span (raman_physics.profile, fiber card RAMAN-G652) followed by a passive loss T and a lumped amplifier, Equation (16).
reference_plane: a,b: fiber ends of the erbium-doped fiber (circulator, isolator and pump-coupler losses not included; FRM reflectance included). c: span input to amplifier output; F_amp refers to the amplifier input port; T is the loss between span output and that port.
notes: Configuration values chosen for the examples and assumed component values. They are not device data and must be reported with every number derived from them.

L_edf.applies_to: length of the erbium-doped fiber in the single-pass and double-pass test case (fiber card EDFA-GD91-T1)

L_edf_long.derivation: 2 L_edf: single pass through the fiber length that the signal traverses in the double pass

P_pump.applies_to: forward pump power at z = 0; pump wavelength lambda_p of card EDFA-GD91-T1 (1480 nm)

R_frm.applies_to: power reflectance of the Faraday rotator mirror at z = L for signal and ASE (double pass); the residual pump is not reflected

ase_bw_nominal.applies_to: width of the single lumped ASE band (1535-1565 nm), centered at the signal wavelength and using the 1550 nm coefficients of EDFA-GD91-T1

ase_bw_low.applies_to: lower end of the sensitivity range of the lumped ASE band (1545-1555 nm)

ase_bw_high.applies_to: upper end of the sensitivity range of the lumped ASE band (1525-1575 nm)

pin_min.applies_to: lowest signal input power of panels a,b

pin_max.applies_to: highest signal input power of panels a,b

L_span.applies_to: length of the counter-pumped distributed Raman span of panel c (fiber card RAMAN-G652)

Gon_max.applies_to: largest Raman on-off gain of panel c

NF_soa.applies_to: noise figure of the SOA at its input port; representative value, not a device measurement

NF_edfa.applies_to: noise figure of the EDFA at its input port; representative value, not a device measurement

T_base_db.applies_to: passive loss between span output and amplifier input port in the base case (T = 1, as in the submitted version)

T_variant_db.applies_to: illustrative passive loss between span output and amplifier input port, for example a pump coupler and a band demultiplexer in front of the amplifier (Reviewer 2, point M15); not a measured value

source.locator: full text, hybrid Raman/SOA transmission experiment (as read by the analysis team, A_r2_misc_and_editor.md, point R2-M15)

G_onoff_exp.applies_to: average distributed Raman on-off gain of the hybrid Raman/SOA experiments of [21, 97]: five backward pumps at 1410-1510 nm, signals at 1515-1618 nm, 100 km spans with 20 dB loss

verification.note: approximate value; to be confirmed by the authors in the full text of [21]

source.locator: as read by the analysis team

L_span_ref21.applies_to: span length of the experiments of [21, 97]

source.locator: as read by the analysis team

span_loss_ref21.applies_to: span loss of the experiments of [21]

source.locator: as read by the analysis team

NF_soa_ref21.applies_to: noise figure of the ultra-wideband SOA module of [21] (two single-polarization chips in polarization diversity); used for a sensitivity value only
